next.reason: 1985: 'Detail report groups are processed by the report writer control system as a direct result of GENERATE statements. If a report group is other than TYPE DETAIL, its processing is an automatic report writer control system function.' 2023: §2023:13.18.57.4 GR5 'Detail report groups are printed when referenced explicitly in a GENERATE statement. All other report groups are printed implicitly'; §2023:14.9.16.4 GR1 (GENERATE data-name prints the detail) and §2023:14.9.16.4 GR2 (GENERATE report-name-1 gives 'the same processing ... except that no detail is printed', as 1985 GR11d). 'Only during the execution of a GENERATE or a TERMINATE statement' matches the 1985 GENERATE/TERMINATE rules. Same meaning.
